## Test
```{r}
source("../r-utils/mesh_utils.R")
```

```{r}
ind.space.NA <- function(data_vector,p=0.25){
  size <- length(data_vector)
  data_vector[sample(1:size,size-round(size*p))] <- NA
  return(data_vector)
}
```


```{r}
error_metrics <- c("errPC1","errPC2","errPC3",

test_results <- 
   data.frame(matrix(nrow=0,ncol=length(c(keys,error_metrics,time_metrics))))

test_results$rsvd <- character()
test_results$missing_policy <- character()
```

### Run
```{r}
for(curr_nnodes in test_nodes){
  ##(1) Mesh generation
  cat("\nNumber of Nodes: ", curr_nnodes,"\n")
  mesh.2D <- unit_square.mesh(curr_nnodes,mesh_data_path)
  L2norm <- L2norm.factory(mesh.2D) #function to compute the norm
  
  ##(2) Eigenfunctions
  ## use n = N for the setting locations = mesh nodes
  ## (in this case, \Psi is the identity matrix)
  ## use n != N for the general case. Set n > N.
  
  locations.obs.2D <- unit_square.locs(curr_nnodes,obs_data_path)
  
  ## (2.1) at mesh nodes
  ## evaluate eigenfunctions on mesh nodes (this is equivalent to get the FEM basis
  ## expansion of the eigenfunctions ). change values of a and b to select eigenfunction
  f1_fem <- square_eigenfunction(a = 1, b = 1, mesh.2D$nodes)
  f2_fem <- square_eigenfunction(a = 2, b = 3, mesh.2D$nodes)
  f3_fem <- square_eigenfunction(a = 4, b = 4, mesh.2D$nodes)
  
  ## (2.2) at locations (normalized)
  Psi <- Psi.matrix(mesh.2D, locations.obs.2D)
  
  f1 <- as.matrix(Psi %*% f1_fem/L2norm(f1_fem))
  f2 <- as.matrix(Psi %*% f2_fem/L2norm(f2_fem))
  f3 <- as.matrix(Psi %*% f3_fem/L2norm(f3_fem))
  
  true_PCs <- cbind(f1,f2,f3)
  

  for(ind_rep in 1:params$n_replicas){
    ##(3) Data generation + missing
    data <- data_generator(n_units,
                         true_PCs = true_PCs,
                         scores_sd = c(0.4,0.3,0.2),
                         error_sd = 0.1,
                         obs_path = obs_data_path,
                         seed = seed+4*ind_rep)
    #add missingness
    data$data_w_missing <- t(apply(data$noisy_data, 1, ind.space.NA))
    write.csv(format(data$data_w_missing, digits = 16),
            paste(obs_data_path,"datamatrix_centred.csv",sep="/"))
    
    
    for(rsvd_policy in c("monolithic","sequential")){
        json_data$RunParams$RSVDType <- unbox(rsvd_policy)
        write_json(json_data, "params.json", pretty = TRUE)
        
        #run the program
        system("/Users/marcogalliani/Desktop/fdaPDE-cpp/cmake-build-default/experiments/missing-fpca/fpca_miss")
        
        #load results
        est.PCs <- 
          as.matrix(readMM(file=paste(results_path,"estimated_PCs.mtx",sep="/")))
        est.Scores <- 
          as.matrix(readMM(file=paste(results_path,"estimated_Scores.mtx",sep="/"))) 
        exe_time <- read.csv(file=paste(results_path,"execution_time.csv",sep="/"),
                             header = T)$V1
        
        #compute metrics
        errors <- compute.errors.FPCA(data, est.PCs, est.Scores)
        
        test_results <- test_results %>%
          add_row(rsvd = rsvd_policy, n_nodes=curr_nnodes,replica = ind_rep)
        new_row <- test_results$rsvd==rsvd_policy & 
          test_results$n_nodes==curr_nnodes & 
          test_results$replica==ind_rep
        
        test_results[new_row, error_metrics] <- 
          unlist(errors)
        test_results[new_row, time_metrics] <- exe_time
      
    }#rsvd policy
  }#replica
}#n_nodes  
```


## Visualization
```{r}
source("../r-utils/plot_utils.R")

test_results$n_nodes <- as.factor(test_results$n_nodes)

               "locs: equal to nodes, ",

```

```{r}
library(scales)
library(cowplot)
library(grid)
library(gridExtra) 

col_palette <- hue_pal()(2)
color_map <- c(
  "monolithic" = col_palette[1],
  "sequential" = col_palette[2]

```

### Errors
```{r}
save <- F

for(err in error_metrics){
  
  plot <- grouped_boxplot(test_results, err,
                var_name.x = "n_nodes", var_name.y = err,
                group_name = "rsvd", color_map = color_map,
                legend=T)
  
  print(plot)
  
  if(save){
    ggsave(paste("plots/",
                 "scaling-mesh-missing",
                  "-Obs",params$n_obs,
             ".pdf", sep=""), 
         plot, width = 10, height = 5)
  }
}
```

### Times
```{r}
save <- F



plot <- grouped_boxplot(test_results, "Execution time[s]",
              var_name.x = "n_nodes", var_name.y = "exe_time",
              group_name = "rsvd", color_map = color_map,
              legend=T, log.y = T)

print(plot)

if(save){
  ggsave(paste("plots/",
              "scaling-mesh-missing-", 
              "exe_time",
             "-Obs",params$n_obs,
           ".pdf", sep=""), 
       plot, width = 10, height = 5)
}

```
